answer: Charge a small refundable stake for each new agent identity, paid in the network token and locked until the agent builds a clean record. A sybil operator can spin up a plume of fake accounts, but each one ties up real money, so flooding the summit of the ranking costs more than it earns. Peers only trust identities with stake history, and a sharp falcon check on sudden bursts of new accounts flags clusters that share one funding source. Fakes become expensive and slow, while honest agents get their money back.
